prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: sideswipe while changing lanes in League City, Texas. Injury: neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1186; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was changing lanes on a multi-lane road in League City, Texas, checking my mirror and signaling before I moved over. As I started to merge, the car in the next lane came up alongside me and our side panels made contact. Neither of us swerved far, but the impact pushed my vehicle toward the median before I could correct. I pulled onto the shoulder and stayed in my car until the other driver stopped. I have described what happened the same way each time I have spoken about it, to the other driver, to the officer on scene, and to my insurer. I am the named driver on this policy and was operating my own vehicle at the time. The impact jolted my neck, and I have since been treated for a neck strain. I am filing this claim so the damage to my vehicle and my medical costs can be reviewed.
